title: Wild Race Master 3d
description: Wild Race Master 3D is an exciting 3D racing game that brings you into a world of extreme speed!In this game, you can experience endless racing fun and drive various cool cars. Challenge the exciting track! ? Drive your beloved racing car through various unique and challenging tracks. You should show excellent driving skills on winding roads and be flexible when dealing with various complex track conditions.

title: Wordler
description:
It's the same English word guessing game as Hackman I played when I was young.
You are given six chances to guess a word that consists of only five letters.
How many times can you get it right?

title: Quiz Squid Round
description: Dive into the trivia world with Quiz Squid Game. This unique game puts your knowledge of the popular series to test. Not just about general knowledge, but the devil is in the details of this mysterious and thrilling TV show. Get ready to answer questions about plot twists, characters, and little known facts about-in game universe. Impress your friends with your trivia skills and detailed memory of this cinema spectacle.

title: Puzzle Wood Block
description:
Put the given blocks of pattern in 9x9 squares to fill them.
Once the 9x9 slots are all Filled up, the blocks in it will be cleared!
Achieve high score by clearing many combos at once!

title: Mow It
description: Mow It Harvest is a colorful simulator in which you will have a farm and your own harvester at your disposal. You need to cut grass, sell colorful hay and move on to new levels. Cut grass like a real farmer and become a millionaire in this bright, exciting game!

title: BMG: CrashDay 2025
description: The game "BMG: CrashDay 2025" is an arcade racing simulator that combines elements of action and realism. Players can choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique characteristics and appearance. The game has various tracks, each with its own features, such as difficult turns, steep climbs and descents, as well as various obstacles.

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Larry World
description:
A fun and challenging platformer game inspired on the greatests classics of its kind.
Help Larry to pass through 4 fantastic worlds.

title: Christmas sorting
description:
Christmas Sorting is a relaxing game for all ages. Place objects next to each other to collect 3 identical objects in a row.
Collect all the unique decorations for a Christmas atmosphere.
Create Christmas coziness, decorate the Christmas tree the way you want.

title: Skating Park
description: Welcome to Skating Park, where skateboards meet high-speed racing madness! Dive into a world of adrenaline-fueled stunts and fierce competition as you shred through gravity-defying tracks. Master insane ramps, outmaneuver opponents, and conquer the leaderboard. Feel the thrill as you jump off the track, taking daring shortcuts to gain the edge. Get ready to grind and glide your way to victory!

title: Doomsday Zombie TD
description: Doomsday Zombie TD is a cool and exciting tower defense game. You aim to defend your castle from brutal enemy attacks and take down the zombie army. Depending on your defense strategy, you can upgrade your buildings, towers, arsenal, and army. Lead your army to defend the castle and kill the zombie hordes. Enjoy!

title: Halloween Store Sort
description: In Halloween Store Sort, match spooky toys and Halloween decorations by dragging them between shelves. Create sets of three to clear the shelves and reveal hidden ones above or to the sides of the screen. With many levels and increasing difficulty, each level has a time limit, so think fast! Use the shuffle button if you get stuck. Complete all levels to win and become the ultimate Halloween sorting champion!

title: Force Master 3D
description: Force Master 3D is a battle Math online game for boys for free. In the game, all the enemies are waiting for you at each level. You need to give priority to attacking monsters lower than yourself. The more monsters you attack, the higher your level will be. Be sure to pay attention to your own strength, because only in this way can you not be destroyed by the enemy!

title: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend
description: One day when I woke up, I saw that my girlfriend wasn't beside me, so I started searching around for her but couldn't find her. Then I noticed a letter on the table, and the letter said: "If you want to see your girlfriend again, you'll have to pass through the magic forest to rescue her, but it won't be easy because you're not alone in the forest!" At first, I didn't understand, but..

title: Hexa Tile Trio
description: Welcome to Hexa Tile Trio! Your goal is to clear the board by sorting hex tiles into groups of three. Tap a tile to move it to an empty or matching spot below. If no tiles fit, or you run out of space, the level fails. With a ticking clock and unique  puzzles, can you master the hex tiles before time runs out?

title: Super Sniper Missions
description: Are you ready to experience an exciting first-person shooter game, Super Sniper Missions gives you an addictive shooting experience. You travel through various cities as a sniper who upholds the city's justice. Your mission is to kill the criminals within a limited time while keeping the hostages safe. Unlock and collect M74, 98K, and other sniper rifles, join us Save the hostages, and become the army's top sniper!

title: Block Stacking
description: Block Stacking is a very fun, leisure, and pressure-relieving game. The game is very delicate and fresh. In the game, you will play by combining many different fruits. As long as you can complete the target tasks, you will have a chance to get rewards! By eliminating the fruits on the screen, you can successfully pass the level. It's extremely easy to operate, which makes you feel very addicted. Come and try the game!

title: My Parking Lot
description: Welcome to "My Parking Lot," the ultimate puzzle challenge! Navigate through a chaotic mess of cars stuck in a parking lot and strategize to safely remove each vehicle without crashing them into each other. Your goal? Clear the parking lot by guiding all the cars to the exit, unlocking new levels as you master the art of precision parking. Can you untangle the traffic and solve each puzzle with finesse? Test your skills in "My Parking Lot" now!

title: Crazy Axe
description:
In Crazy Axe, you take control of a fearless warrior, armed with a powerful axe, to conquer a series of action-packed challenges. Swing your axe with precision, crush obstacles, and defeat waves of enemies. The game tests your reflexes and accuracy as you navigate through dangerous environments, dodging traps and outsmarting your foes. With each level, the difficulty ramps up, demanding quick thinking and faster reactions to survive.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and go axe-crazy?

title: Zen Tile
description: Are you a master player of matching games? Do you enjoy matching puzzle games? Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game: Zen Tile - Relaxing Match!

title: That's Not My Neighbor
description: That's Not My Neighbor is a detective puzzle game. You are going to be the new janitor in this building when you are watching the tutorial video. Your job is to determine if the person who wants to enter the building is a monster. The monsters can transform into anyone and imitate them. Some monsters are not good at imitation and may develop flaws. You have no choice but to pay attention to the image of your neighbors. At the same time, remember to fill out checklists for each neighbor.

title: Juicy Match
description: Tired of candies? Dive into Juicy Match and explore a world of natural, fresh, and juicy delights! You run the best Juice Bar in town, where you match a variety of fruits, from tropical to classic, to create the perfect juice blends. Your cheerful friend, Tiki will guide you with tips and tricks. Match three or more identical fruits to juice them and complete levels. Create chain reactions for extra bonuses and points. Enjoy a refreshing, juicy adventure with Juicy Match!

title: Animerge
description:
Animerge is a cute, fun and cozy casual game where players merge cute adorable animals, starting from the tiniest mouse, all the way to the majestic elephant! 

Combining these animals playing solo or battling with friends, the cozy Lo-Fi music and hand drawn art create the perfect atmosphere for unwinding. 

Merge, strategize, and relax in this fun and laid-back adventure!

title: Paperly - Paper Plane Adventure
description:
Go on an exciting paper plane flight adventure, learn different flight mechanics & reach your destination.

PAPERLY: PAPER PLANE ADVENTURE - is all about Flying a Paper Plane, learning from previous mistakes, and Heading toward a Better Flight in this Physics-Driven Gameplay.

title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
description:
Flashy and modified super-sports cars and their drivers are ready for the show in Real Cars Epic Stunts game. Play against time in dozens of different stunt tracks and try to complete the show. Unlock new cars or upgrade your car with the coins and diamonds you collect.

Game Features:

● Realistic car physics and appearance. ( Cars get crushed and smashed )
● Upgradeable cars
● 1 Player and 2 Player modes
● Mega ramps for epic stunts

title: Slope Spooky
description: Slope Spooky is a Halloween-themed! A ball rolling down difficult and eerie slopes is controlled by the players. It's almost Halloween, which means Slope needs some scary stuff!

title: Underwater Survival Deep Dive
description: This is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet. You'll encounter a vast open world filled with wonders and dangers! Survival in this alien oceanic world demands quick thinking and resourcefulness. Your ship is your raft.

title: Pin Puzzle Save The Sheep
description: Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep is an exciting pin-pulling game. You will test your brain intelligence and have endless fun. In this game, you have to make the sheep eat food and save them from their predicament. You have many other tasks like pulling the pin to make the dog eat the food. But be aware that you may meet a lot of obstacles like bombs, lava, etc. and you need to avoid them. There are many interesting levels to play in this crazy puzzle game. Come and join the game.

title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
description:
You will be immersed in the dangerous world of ninja art, where every movement, every breath are decisive moments in your mission.

Your goal is to approach your enemies unnoticed, and to achieve this, you will have to skillfully use your blade to cut through the bamboo thickets, making your way through the dense forest.

But be on your guard, your enemies are not slumbering, and you can be detected at any moment.

title: Obby Climb Racing
description: In the adventure game Obby Climb Racing, players may spend a lot of time racing on insane roads, acquiring interesting skins, improving Obby's bike, and completing difficult parkour courses. For fans of fast-paced, skill-based games, this is a must-play because of the thrilling combination of racing, platforming, and character advancement. In this adrenaline-pumping game, you'll have to crank your engines, level up your character, and complete parkour tasks.

title: Mahjong Masters
description:
Enter the world of Mahjong Masters, where classic Mahjong meets fast-paced tile matching! 
In this exciting game, players have 2 minutes to match as many Mahjong tile pairs as possible. 
Each round is a thrilling battle against a new opponent. 
Accumulate battle points with each victory to climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate Mahjong Master.

title: Ninja Crossword Challenge
description: It's time to test your vocabulary with Ninja Crossword Challenge, an educational puzzle online game for everyone, and a free game for kids to improve their vocabulary. All you have to do is fill in the words in the grid, the game has more vocabulary than you can imagine, ready to take on my challenge?

title: Halloween Stickman
description: On Halloween when the air was thick with mystery and the streets were decorated with carved pumpkins, you were ready to enjoy the spooky night. But Stickman, your sly friend and perennial trickster set you up and you are in trouble. It's time to punish him in every possible way. How? Yes, you have the super ability to rewind time. So take advantage of it and  punish your enemy on Halloween!

title: Wild Tanks
description:
Wild Tanks includes two game modes.
This is a survival race and tough tank battles.

Compete in tank races with shooting, earn stars, level up the tanker, upgrade your tank.
Take part in epic tank battles and destroy the enemy.

Break, destroy, destroy everything. Drive through the mountains, crush soldiers, blow up the enemy, have fun to the fullest!

title: Hero Fight Clash
description: A thrilling adventure, hearty duel, don't you want to play a horizontal fighting game like Hero Fight Clash? Various cool skills, choose your favorite hero, keep adventuring, keep upgrading, and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: Turbo Race 3D
description: Get ready for intense action in Turbo Race 3D! Upgrade your car’s speed, acceleration, grip, and brakes to dominate the competition. Use shields and boosters to gain an edge, and customize your ride with decals and colors. Race through 3 exciting worlds—city, desert, and snow—while evading traffic and outpacing opponents on thrilling highways. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate racer?

title: Monster Girls Back to School
description: Welcome to Monster Girls Back To School. Join the Monster Girls as they prep for school! Assist them in selecting the ideal outfits for a stylish return. Dive into their supernatural world, full of fashion choices and exciting back-to-school adventures. Get ready to be their fashion guide and have fun!

title: Over the Rainbow
description: Help Alex the Elf return the colors to the rainbow by jumping. Avoid enemies and find power ups to aid you in your quest.

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: Math Quest
description: "Math Quest" - an exciting game for the whole family that develops mathematical skills, logic, and reaction speed. Overcome challenges, calculate correct answers, and reach new levels!

title: Jelly Block Puzzle
description: Dive into the fun with our vibrant jelly merging game! Explore a world filled with countless levels, merge jellies, use power-ups, and stay entertained. Challenge your brain and see how far you can go in this delightful, jelly-colored adventure!

title: Farm Block Puzzle
description: This is the perfect game to satisfy your craving for a logical tetris-inspired game with a fresh spin on it. The countryside aesthetic will capture your attention with its beautiful graphics and lovely music.

title: Mech Monster Arena
description: Mech Monster Arena is a robot-fighting turn-based strategy game. Differently in this fighting game, you don't need to learn how to operate the robot and release each skill. You only need to learn the basic skill counter rules and select the skills flexibly. By earning EXPs and coins from battles in Mech Battle, you can fight with AI opponents and develop your robot. When you have some sources to upgrade your robot in the Mech Warehouse, you can challenge other players in the Arena. Have fun!

title: Get a cool gun!
description:
The dynamic gun runner game gives a shooting experience with the creation and evolution of weapons. Combine parts to get new weapon modules.
Shoot obstacles and enemies to unlock an arsenal of powerful weapons. Test your marksmanship by shooting at targets and enemies.
Improve your firepower by creating and combining weapon parts. Follow the evolution of weapons, from simple firearms to advanced weaponry. Become a true master of weapon creation!

title: Super Bitcoin Boy
description: “Super Bitcoin Boy” is a “Mario Bros” style platform game, themed around the Bitcoin cryptocurrency, eliminate enemies, overcome obstacles, collect all the bitcoins to get the highest score possible. Enjoy the Halving year, have fun playing and complete all levels.

title: Hide Moodeng Hippo!
description:
Evil flea balls are raining down from above, and it's your job to keep the adorable baby hippo, Moodeng, safe! 
Tap on various objects in each level to activate, building a sturdy shelter for Moodeng. 


Key Features:
- 50+ levels of exciting and brain-teasing puzzles.
- Physics-based gameplay where every move counts.
- Fun, adorable 2D graphics and engaging challenges.
- A variety of objects to interact with, providing endless strategies for success.

title: Seek & Find
description: Dive into a fun puzzle hidden object game with intrigue and excitement in "Seek & Find-Hidden Object Game," where keen eyes and quick wits reign supreme. This scavenger hunt game invites players of all ages to find hidden objects through beautifully crafted scenes, exploring maps and secrets skillfully concealed within. With a blend of charm and challenge, this fun hidden object game is designed to captivate, entertain, and test your observational skills like never before!

title: Doggo Jump
description: "Doggo Jump" is a charming hyper-casual platform game where players controls a playful puppy as it hops between platforms, collecting bones and racking up points. With simple tap-to-jump mechanics, colorful graphics, and an adorable dog character, the game is easy to pick up and addictive, making it perfect for quick gaming sessions.

title: Mermaidcore Makeup
description: In Mermaidcore Makeup, you ladies can step into the shoes of a talented makeup artist and work your magic on three stunning ladies. Journey into the realm of fantasy as you help these beauties achieve their perfect, enchanting looks. Prepare for a sensational trip filled with endless options as you explore an extensive selection of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascara, lipsticks, face patterns, and intricate shoulder and neck patterns that perfectly match each girl's unique style and personality.

title: Solitaire L'Amour
description: Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire! Enter an enchanting world as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure!

title: Kitchen Star
description: Introducing "Kitchen Star," the ultimate puzzle challenge for visual thinkers! In this captivating game, players are tasked with unraveling intricate images by strategically rotating connected chunks of lines. Your mission? Reveal the full image in as few turns as possible by rotating different sections. With each twist and turn, the true picture emerges, but can you decode it before you're all twisted up? Get ready to sharpen your spatial skills and become the ultimate Kitchen Star!

title: Paint race
description: Run around the circle and jump over dark obstacles. Paint the circle to pass levels. Collect the stars. Enjoy and get fun.

title: Police Chase Drifter
description:
Police Chase Drifter is a fun car game where you get to run from the police, collect money bags and reach to the finishline.
Earn money to buy more cars, fasters and enjoy the drifting.

title: Zombie Chase
description: In Zombie Chase, players navigate a chaotic world filled with the undead, using every ounce of strategic prowess to outlast the apocalypse. This is not a typical racing game, youll need to manage resources and make smart decisions to survive the relentless zombie hordes. Your brain isnt just a desirable snack for zombies in this game - its your greatest weapon!

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: Brain Puzzle Tricky Choices
description: This is a brain puzzle game. In this Brain Puzzle: Tricky Choices game, use your imaginative brain to solve all the tricky brain puzzles, find the right storyline, and then pass the level. It may be easy to get through all the levels, all you need to do is make the right choices, sounds simple but it's not. Join the game and use your imagination and creativity to solve the puzzles!

title: Solve the Cube Wooden Blocks 2D!
description:
• This is a game in which you have to connect wooden blocks! In the game you have a playing area where you must connect blocks to fill the line! Once the line is full, the blocks will disappear, giving you the most
points! Compete with friends or colleagues on the leaderboard! Enjoy your game!

title: Merge Heroes
description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

title: Bomb Head Hot Potato
description:
In the game "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" your goal is to stay alive and not die from the bomb in your hand. Drop bombs on your opponents to win! 
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" and prove your survival skills and tactical thinking!

title: Family Tree Emoji
description:
Is a logic game that combines the excitement of deciphering with the surprise of bizarre combinations.

The game will come across family trees with missing cells, you need to choose the emoji that fits into that gap.

Look at the parents and children to find commonalities and complete all levels.

title: Boxteria
description:
Dive into an amazing cubic world, where you can become anyone from a BANDIT to a ZOMBIE attacking everyone around! Imagine having 20 super cool cars at your disposal to ride, drift, and have fun on maps like "Russian Village," and "Courtyard," spaces filled with adventures.

You'll enjoy creating characters, each unique in their own way. You can assemble a team of bandits, zombies, or even police officers and engage in thrilling battles or cool races.

title: Passenger Sort
description: Play Passenger Sort free online and take control in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Guide travelers to the right buses, planes, and trains in a clever logic puzzle that works as a fun brain game for all ages. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart sorting challenges anytime.

title: Pirate Noob Apocalypse
description: It's time to enjoy yourself with this Pirate Noob Apocalypse game. A little pirate noob is getting ready to go out and battle many zombies that have arisen to take over the planet and all seafaring vessels. You may have a great time playing this engaging action and shooting game and rising to the position of the greatest pirate around.

title: Bubble Shooter Panda Blast
description:
Step into the colorful world of Panda Blast, where your mission is to rescue baby pandas by popping bubbles. Mama Panda needs your help to bring her lost cubs home. With vibrant graphics, charming animations, and exciting puzzles, this game is perfect for all ages.
Match three or more bubbles to clear them, free trapped pandas, and progress through hundreds of fun levels. Use powerful boosters, enjoy daily rewards, and experience smooth animations that bring the adventure to life.

title: Organizer master
description: An engaging 3D puzzle with numerous levels. Find pairs and arrange objects so that everything fits. Develop spatial thinking and solve challenges. Enjoy high-quality 3D graphics in this captivating browser puzzle game.

title: Drop Bricks Breaker
description: Drop Bricks Breaker is an interesting casual puzzle game. You can relax yourself during play time. You only need to tap the screen to aim the bricks, then launch the ball. Isn't easy it? Come to try it now! Have a great time!

title: Gross Out Run
description: Gross Out Run is a parkour game. Compete against two other AI runners and the first player to reach the finish line wins! Be careful, you have to avoid the sledgehammers on the road, which will block your progress and stain your clothes simultaneously. It's time to make a change! Can you get to the finish line first and keep yourself tidy?

title: Rush Car Driving - Race Master
description:
Rush Car Driving: Race Master is a driving game that delivers thrilling action as you navigate heavy traffic. 

Experience the adrenaline of high-speed racing in heavy traffic, where split-second decisions can be the difference between victory and defeat. Explore a variety of immersive environments, from busy urban highways to rural roads. 

Choose from a wide selection of cars, from sports cars to muscle machines. Buckle up and start the race!

title: Diamond mosaic
description: Ready to create your own masterpiece from a scattering of diamonds on your screen? Come to our mosaic!  Fill images with diamond scatter!

title: Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge
description: This is simple but addictive chicken jump game. You'll have lots of levels and you have to save your chicken but swiping on screen from bottom to up to make chicken jump so that it can avoid hurdles.

title: Royal Jewels Match
description: Matching jewels has never been so much fun! Unlock unique levels, participate in special events and take on surprising challenges. Collect coins with your matches and show off your decorating skills. Earn crowns as you progress and become a true master of the game!

title: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt
description: Journey into an ancient Egyptian night in Bubble Shooter Pyramid Quest! Match and pop glossy bubbles to climb rising score goals. Fill the goal bar to trigger quick celebrations, then push onward as the ceiling creeps closer. Beat your High score, earn a second chance with a rewarded continue, and watch desert backdrops shift as you progress. Easy to start, hard to master—aim, bounce, and clear your way to legend! Start in Beginner, then unlock Medium and Hard as your score surges ever higher!

title: Farm Mahjong 3D
description: Have you ever imagined playing your favorite 3D mahjong game in a farm setting? Mahjong 3D Farm does just that! It brings the popular Mahjong 3D game into the charming world of farms, filled with adorable animals, crops, and farming tools for you to match! So why wait? Play Mahjong 3D Farm Connect now and solve the puzzle amidst the fields!

title: Battle Arena
description: Fight enemies, grow your army, and dominate the battlefield! Upgrade your camp, train your soldiers and earn tons of coins to expand your unstoppable arsenal. Ready to battle?

title: Russian Treasure Hunter
description: You're a prospector in a big mining town: grab your device, head to a location, and search for hidden items. As your device's signal grows, you're near a treasure trove; dig up a find and take it back to town to sell. The game combines tactical exploration, economics, and collecting: clever backpack management, purchasing upgrades, and choosing the right moment to return to town determine whether you'll make a profit or leave empty-handed.

title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
description: Build-A-Flop: The Sickman Playground is not just a game—it's a people's playground of laughter and creativity! With its whimsical world and endless opportunities for hilarity, it's sure to become a favorite among players of all ages.

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Mr Reckless: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, Nitro to escape the impossible.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Stickman Miners Wars
description: Lead your stickman king to victory in Stickman Miners Wars, where strategic decision-making is key. Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Draw Climb Race - The Ultimate Hill Climbing Challenge
description: In Draw Climb Race, you draw shapes to climb hills! Any drawing you make will help you climb up steep hills and tricky paths. If you get stuck, just draw a new shape to keep going. Have fun and test your skills in this easy-to-play, addictive game!

title: Tiny Fighter - Unstoppable Run
description:
10 Levels of an exciting and action-packed game that brings player to a mysterious woods and castles. The game begins with a dramatic scenario in which a vampire has stolen the princess and the brave Tiny Knight is the only one who can save her.

As the princess is abducted, the Tiny Knight embarks on a quest to retrieve her by through dangerous woodlands and battle his way through the castle's maze. Along the journey, the knight must fight Orcs, Skeletons and win Dracula to save the princess!

title: Traffic Cop 3D
description: Traffic Cop 3D is a casual game where you play as a police officer enforcing the law of the road. Scan nearby drivers and use intel from the police database to decide whether you should pull them over, or let them go, all while progressing through the story and increasing your duties as a cop.

title: Stacking Match
description: Jenga match is a very fun puzzle game. Players need to pull out blocks of a certain color from a multi-layered tower of blocks. The pulled block will fly into the corresponding colored square. When there are three blocks of the same color in a square, it will eliminated, and a new square will appear. How many levels you can play?

title: School simulator: My school
description:
Welcome to School Simulator: My School! In this game you need to manage your school, open new classrooms, toilets, canteen, hire staff and help students to learn.
The more classes, the more schoolchildren. The more schoolchildren, the more money. The more money, the more opportunities to develop the school.

title: Wreck The Tower
description: Take control of a powerful tank and unleash destruction in Wreck The Tower, an explosive demolition game where precision and power determine your success! Your mission is simple: demolish buildings by firing your tank’s bullets repeatedly until the structure collapses. But be careful not to hit the moving walls. If you hit them, your bullet will ricochet back toward you, adding an extra challenge to your aim.

title: Obby Parkour Racing
description:
Welcome to Obby Parkour Racing – the game where speed, agility, and style collide to create the ultimate racing challenge!

Jump, grind, and dodge through dynamic obstacle courses on your snowboard! Prove your mastery in a world where parkour isn't just on foot
it's on a board. Every race is a new test, and only the fastest and most agile champions will claim victory.

title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
description: Pixel Fun - Color By Number is a fun coloring game that lets you bring pixel art to life. With casual number-based instructions, you’ll fill in each pixel square to reveal stunning artwork.Each image is divided into tiny pixels. Each is assigned a number that corresponds to a color. For example, click on the city scene to fill in color and light up the street.

title: Idle Inventor
description:
Grow your industrial powerhouse: become a heavy machine titan of industry!

Manufacture cars, trucks, planes, military vehicles, and high-tech instruments for space exploration!

Watch your factory grow from a single production line to a world-famous industrial powerhouse. And because you’re automating, your factory keeps working while you’re away - check in the morning,  it’s amazing to see how much money you made while sleeping

Try it now, and see how the idle tycoon life suits you!

title: Square World 3D
description: Square World 3D invites you into a completely open and huge craft world. In this world, you can use dozens of items / mines to design most of the things you can imagine and take actions in a world of your own. For example, first design, then fly over your unique design using the flying mode! This wonderful simulation game may become addictive for you. It is possible to design a completely different world in every game.

title: Sniper 3D Zombie
description: Defend your position from the zombie invasion. You have a sniper rifle, find and eliminate zombies. Hitting a zombie is not difficult, it is much more difficult to detect it. The enemies are cunning and very well disguised, they are able to blend in with the environment. Shoot the zombies and take the first places in the leaderboard!

title: Motorcycle simulator offline
description: Get ready for an exotic stunt master & adventurous high ground city jumper sports bike simulator game.For bike racing fans and motor bike riders this exotic sports bike simulator is a real fun game. Just start your engine and hit the gas of an extreme bike to experience the stunt master thrill of high ground city jumper motorbike racing & enjoy sports bike sound.

title: Boss Market
description: You are the owner of your market. Customers are coming to buy various products. Collect these products and place them into correct stands so that customers can buy them. Collect money from customers and open new markets and become a market boss!

title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
description:
SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY ??

OREN, a genius (but reckless) surgeon, must save PINKI after a brutal facial injury—without anesthesia! As more SPRUNKIS like TUNNER, shot in the head, flood the ER, OREN races against time. But lurking in the shadows is BLACK, ready to turn OREN’s mission into a nightmare. Will OREN save them all, or will BLACK end it in tragedy?

title: Holiday Hex Sort
description: In Holiday Hex Sort, drag and drop hex tile stacks onto the board. Merge tiles to form stacks of 10 and collect them. As levels progress, more tile types appear. If there are 10 similar tiles on a stack, they will be collected. Clear all tiles by making stacks of 10 before time runs out !

title: Cargo Skates
description:
No obstacles, no matter how high, can stop me from collecting more goods.
Pass the obstacles and finally collect enough goods.
Now, your supermarket can open

title: Biking Extreme 3D
description: Do you like riding a mountain bike? Biking Extreme 3D offers you a chance to ride a mountain bike and challenge multiplayer mountain racing tracks. It doesn't matter when you crash any other riders on the track, they will be crashed into the sky. But please always keep a safe distance between your vehicle and obstacles like trees and rocks. Or else, you will lose the game directly. The coins you won are used to upgrade your bike. Don't forget to try another 5 characters!

title: Chicken Wild Run
description: Aim for the goal while collecting coins! Tap to change direction left and right. When your stamina runs out, the game is over. Get a kiss from a cute girl and become invincible! In invincible mode, you can bounce off obstacles. If you collect 10 mysterious bottles, the coins on the road will turn into high-scoring diamonds for a certain period of time.

title: Bears vs. Art
description:
Bears vs. Art is the premium version of the slash em’ up puzzle game you love! Exclusive to this version of Bears vs. Art - enjoy uninterrupted, thought-provoking puzzles.
Each painting is protected by sneaky security measures including lasers, spikes and mind-bending portals. Not to mention snooty guests, nosy security guards and art-snatching thieves!

title: Count Master Match Color Run
description: Count Master: Match Color Run is a colorful running game where you lead a group of little characters in a color-matching race! In this exciting arcade challenge, collect characters of the same color to grow your team. Merge them for a bigger squad, aiming for the highest score. Avoid hammers, spikes, etc. Collect characters of the same color to expand your team.

title: Daring Jack
description:
Jack, an adventurer, was flying over the sea in his small aircraft. When he reached a jungle island, his aircraft's engine failed and he lost control. He escaped from the crashing aircraft, landed safely on the island, and now must find a boat to leave.

He knows of the old boathouse on the island but is uncertain how to reach it. Guide him through the jungle to the boathouse. Help him gather items for survival, focusing on securing food and shelter while navigating the challenging terrain.

title: Hexa Sort 3D
description: Hexa Sort 3D mixes puzzle challenges, strategic matching and a satisfying merging experience.Involving clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, this game is ideal for those seeking a mental workout. As the levels progress, players will find the game both addictive and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your skills to the test with tasks such as sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles.

title: Pubg Hack
description: Experience the ultimate shooting adventure. In Pubg Hack, you step into the battlefield as an elite soldier, exploring massive maps and engaging in fierce combat. Select a location to land and begin searching for supplies.

title: Ocean Rescue
description: A dark power has invaded the ocean, locking sea creatures in water bubbles. Play as Squiddy, a determined and cute squid on a mission to his besties and meet new friends along the way.

title: My Arcade Center 2
description:
My Arcade Center 2 is a fast-paced arcade management tycoon game.

Build, customize, and expand your own arcade across 7 unique maps. Earn by day, upgrade by night, unlock new machines, hire staff, optimize layouts, and grow your business. Switch between centers anytime, unlock new characters and skins, complete daily missions, and boost your long-term progress with rewarding upgrades.

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Robots Gone Wild
description:
Robots Gone Wild is a thrilling survival game in a sci-fi world with captivating visuals and intense shooting mechanics. Your goal is to escape from rogue robots and destroy them while navigating through hazardous environments.

To survive, keep upgrading your character and weapons.
Improve your armor, and unlock powerful guns to fend off waves of increasingly powerful robots. 

Engage in exciting battles, and explore beautiful environments that immerse you in the chaos of a world gone wild.

title: Stickman Warrior Way
description:
Epic battles, complex labyrinths with multiple paths and treacherous enemies await you in the game!

You will have to pass difficult tests in the fight against an ancient evil that wants to destroy all existing worlds.
 Only you can prevent the destruction of the universe and save other worlds from destruction.

18 challenging levels and mazes are waiting for you.
2 or more ways to pass the level
Save this world to give the rest of the universe a chance!

title: Cute Craft Lab
description: Step into the colorful world of Cute Craft Lab, a super casual game where creativity shines and every girl can become a true crafting designer. If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: Candy Maker: Dessert Games
description: Do you like match-3 games, candies, and delicious cakes? Solve sweet riddles, move puzzles, and collect culinary masterpieces! Train your brain by solving exciting puzzles! Rich graphics and pleasant music will help you relax to your advantage!

title: Real Drive 3D
description:
Are you ready to experience unique car-driving gameplay? Start with your SUV and unlock new vehicles as you progress through the game, playing different and unique levels. Drive your favorite vehicles, and navigate your way around new challenging environments.

We welcome all racing car game fans to experience this new driving game! Real Drive 3D is a car simulation game which will give you a unique arcade experience.

title: Fun IQ Puzzle
description: Fun IQ Puzzle is a vibrant and engaging logic game that test your problem-solving skills with colorful bubble-based puzzles. In Story Mode, we have to unlock locked spaces by placing colorful puzzles in the right spots. In Time Attack Mode, we have to race against the clock to solve puzzles as quick as possible. Challenge yourself to master every stage with this fun puzzle game!

title: Mahjong Earth
description: Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Mahjong Earth! This captivating game offers a tranquil escape with its soothing earth-themed soundtrack and stunning tile designs. Explore over 250+ unique puzzle layouts, each more challenging than the last. Use the Combo meter to match quickly and earn stars. Climb the leaderboard for recognition and claim boosters by reaching the top. Immerse in the relaxing soundtrack and earthy tiles for a truly calming experience!

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Cow Jam Farm puzzle
description: In Cow Jam Farm Puzzle, the peaceful farm turns into a tricky traffic jam that only your logic skills can solve. Cows are stuck in crowded paths, and your mission is to help every one of them escape safely.

title: Brick Game Classic
description: Brick Game Classic is a classic Tetris online game. If you are a fan of classic games, then this game that has been popular for many years is just right for you. When any row or column is filled, it is eliminated. You can change the shape of the cubes before they fall to eliminate them quickly. You can also make them fall faster if you are satisfied with their shape.  Now join the world of fun games.

title: Fish Land Fish World
description: Explore a colorful underwater world full of fishing excitement. In Fish Land - Fish World, you’ll become a fishing expert in this relaxing idle fishing adventure! This game combines simulation and fishing elements. Allow you to fish, expand your pond, and grow your aquatic world.

title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Remove screws in correct order to get rid of the boards. 
Match the removed screws and complete the level. 
Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Crazy Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning supercars with crazy speed limits and drive them through 4 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Crazy Traffic Racer!

title: Skibronx Runner
description: Make your way through the streets in this endless runner game while you encounter various challenges. In the level mode its your goal to reach the grocery store without losing. In the endless mode your goal is to reach as far as possible without losing.

title: Crazy Stunts 3D
description: Get behind the wheel and conquer extreme tracks! Jump from ramps, compete with players, complete modes and unlock new cars!

title: Animal Racing Idle Park
description: Animal Racing: Idle Park is an addictive racing animal transform game that will keep you playing for hours. In this game, you’ll train multiple animal racers such as lions, eagles, orangutans, dolphins, and more!

title: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

The game features many skins for Nubiks, achievements, a leaderboard, and chat.

title: Bike Stunt Racing Legend
description: Bike Stunt Racing Legend is not merely a motorcycle racing but also a balanced stunt simulation game. Under a 3D game engine, you are required to ride the motorbike to the finish line in the first place. As long as you can keep high speed, the AI opponent will make mistakes and lose you. Don't be afraid of rolling ramps, pass the green arrows to speed up more easily. Keep calm and step on the gas!

title: Car Collision Master
description: Rev up for Car Collision Master Jagged canyons frame your blue jeep versus orange-black rivals on a looping desert track. Smoke trails and starry arches amp the chaos—customize your rig, battle friends, and dominate leaderboards in this wheel-warping thrill ride. Feel the V8 roar; claim victory in dust and daring!

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes
description:
Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes is an exciting game in which the player has to become a real wrecking racer.

There are many unique cars available in the game, each of which has its own characteristics and capabilities. From classic sports cars to massive monster trucks, you will have complete freedom to choose the vehicle for your crazy adventures.

title: Bubble classic
description: The goal of the game is not to lose as early as possible and to score as many points as possible. Improve your accuracy thanks to very competent rolling of balls. The more blocks with balls you destroy, the more points you accumulate. Check your results in the world rankings, maybe you are already number 1.

title: Makeup Fruits
description: In Makeup Fruits, give your favorite fruits a stunning makeover! Apply makeup, add accessories, and create fabulous fruit beauty icons. Choose from a variety of makeup options, including powder, lipstick, and eyelashes. Take a "selfie" of your creation and share it with friends! Earn gems to unlock even more fun items and keep the transformation going!

title: Cool Cars: racing at altitude
description:
Cool Cars: racing at altitude is an exciting racing game in which you can buy cars, build your own garage and compete with other players.

Earn points by collecting bonuses on a straight track, compete with other players to complete special tracks against the clock, equip your auto repair shop and collect cool cars!
In the game you will find a large number of cars, exciting tracks, your own garage with purchased cars, the ability to change the environment to suit you and much more.

title: Dragon Escape
description: The cute dinosaur wants to reach the exit by eating Sandwich in the area protected by robots. If you want to help him, try to pass the levels by using laser traps without entering the robots' field of vision.

title: Christmas Candy Escape 3D
description: Christmas Candy Escape 3D is a casual puzzle in which you have to fall safely. It is deceptively simple, yet profoundly deep. Play through the extensive stages, sharpening your wits as you have fun. Have a try!

title: King of Crabs
description: Easy to operate the krab,The Shell Gallery will show each role's armor, speed, skill, and pelt,The Equipment shop sells 5 Claws, 5 Bodies, and 5 Legs, Claim extra claw coins in the Sign and Spin,The Quick Match will make a fight with 24 players.The Ultimate Guide to Winning Tactics and Tips,Find a shell first. Collect and eat fish on the ground to grow up, Attack the weaker opponents.

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: Fruite Swipe
description:
Get ready for a juicy adventure with Fruit Swipe Match, Swipe and match colorful fruits to solve exciting puzzles and unlock fantastic rewards. With hundreds of challenging levels, stunning graphics, and smooth gameplay, this match-3 game will keep you entertained for hours.

Compete with friends, discover hidden treasures, and master fun power-ups. Download Fruit Swipe Match now and experience the ultimate fruit-matching fun. It's time to swipe, match, and win big!

title: Idle Hotel Empire
description:
Grow your hotel empire in this idle tycoon simulation game.

Construct different hotel floors to suit the needs of your customers. This includes construcing standard hotel rooms, cafe bistros, deluxe rooms, meeting rooms for corporate customers, vip rooms, infinity pools, gym and fitness rooms and of course, the bougee presidential suite.

Control hotel employees, move them up and down the elevators to move the cash, and finally CASH it in the reception office.

title: Closed City
description: Shooting game about a quarantined city due to the threat of infection with a zombie virus. The main gameplay will revolve around the fact that you will need to survive in this difficult, riddled city.

title: Strategy of war. Tanks and helicopters.
description:
"Strategy of war" is an exciting strategy war game where the player has to control squads of tanks and helicopters, develop his base, choose battle tactics and fight the enemy.

The game offers a wide range of equipment and weapons, a variety of missions and tasks, as well as the opportunity to improve and develop their forces. It is important to properly allocate resources, as well as use tactical techniques to defeat the enemy.

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Drunk Man 3D
description: Drunk Man 3D is a challenging and comedic 3D Ragdoll Physics game. In this game, players must navigate a treacherous cityscape while emulating the hindered balance of inebriation. The game features ragdoll physics, where even minor collisions can cause players to lose control and stumble.

title: Color Jam 3D
description:
Color Jam 3D is a fun and relaxing match-and-merge puzzle game! Combine crayons of the same colors  to fill the picture and bring stunning images to life with vibrant colors.
With engaging gameplay and satisfying color-filling mechanics, Color Jam 3D offers a unique blend of puzzle-solving and artistic expression.

title: Garten Of BanBan 1 Escape
description:
Enter Banban's Kindergarten, and you're sure to make some friends. Explore the mysterious establishment and don't lose your life and sanity. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the place, but be careful, as you are far from alone…

The Banban And Friends Gang:
Banban’s Kindergarten has earned a special place in every kid’s heart. The reason for this is the Banban And Friends Gang, which are the establishment’s mascots and icons. At Banban’s Kindergarten, nobody’s lonely thanks to them!

title: Hexa Sort Master
description:
Let's sort some hexa blocks on the hexa tiles. Hexa blocks consist of colorful pieces. Place the same colored pieces side by side and match them to stack all hexas over one tile.
A great puzzle game begins with colorful hexa blocks! Sort the stacks side by side and try to destroy them making hexa towers. Match the same colors with each other. Exercise and improve your brain skills. More than 200 levels are waiting for you!

title: Animal Merge Zoo Park
description:
Animal Merge Zoo Park is a fun and addictive idle zoo simulation game where you build, manage, and expand your very own wildlife empire. Start with a small zoo and grow it into a world filled with animals, wild beasts, dinosaurs, monsters, and magical creatures like unicorns. Become the ultimate zoo tycoon by merging creatures, caring for animals, producing food, managing visitors, and unlocking new zones.
Merge Animals and Discover New Species

title: V And N Pizza Cooking Game
description: Experience the ultimate virtual pizza-making adventure with the V And N Pizza Cooking Game! Craft delicious pizzas from scratch, choose mouthwatering toppings, and master the art of baking. From classic favorites to innovative creations, unleash your inner chef and create culinary masterpieces.

title: Cube in Cube
description: Play the new 2048 game with unique mechanics! Develop strategies to clear cubes in endless mode or rescue the monkey. Challenge yourself now!

title: Mega Ramp Car Stunts
description:
Get ready for the ultimate stunt-driving challenge in Mega Ramp Car Stunts! Take control of powerful cars and race down sky-high mega ramps to perform mind-blowing jumps, flips, and tricks. Defy gravity as you soar through the air and land like a pro on impossible tracks.

With dynamic gameplay, extreme stunts, and intense visuals, this is the stunt arena where only the boldest drivers survive!

title: Bubble Sky
description: Bubble Sky is an ascending Bubble Shooter game that will take you to dizzying heights. Will you be able to reach space? Reach a score of 200000 points to unlock the wheel of fortune and win collectible cards to complete your album!

title: Xmas Presents Mahjong
description: Match three of the same tiles. Click on a tile to move it to the collection spots at the bottom. If you have collected three of the same tiles there, they will be removed.

title: Survival Racing: Extreme Road
description:
Imagine that the time has come when ordinary racing is no longer enough adrenaline temptation. In a world where extreme sports are at the peak of popularity, a new competition has appeared - Survival Racing: Extreme Road.

Overcome obstacles, avoid traps and fight your rivals to reach the finish line first. Your goal is not only to win the race, but also to survive in the face of fierce competition.

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Pato Vs Cops
description: lay Pato Vs Cops — the ultimate free browser police chase game! No download needed — jump into nonstop car chases, dodge roadblocks, and outdrive relentless cops in fast-paced arcade action. Perfect for fans of unblocked racing games, endless car chase games, and online driving challenges. Show off your reflexes, collect power-ups, and see how long you can survive the heat in this thrilling high-speed pursuit!

title: Mahjong build farm
description: A cozy blend of classic Mahjong and farm simulation! Start with a small green hill and turn it into a blooming farm by matching tiles and completing levels. The mechanics are simple and relaxing — find and match three identical picture tiles to clear the board. You'll have 90 unique levels with varying difficulty, from easy puzzles to real challenges for experienced players. If you get stuck, bonuses are always there to help.

title: Stellar Fusion
description:
Enter the captivating universe of Celestia —
As the stellar Alchemist, you alone possess the power to restore cosmic balance. Manipulate essences represented by vibrant tiles and solve intricate puzzles to restore balance in Stellar Fusion!

title: Home Block Story
description: Step into a world of renovation! Match blocks, clear the board and unlock new decor to design your house just the way you want. With each new challenge, show your unique style and make your dream home a reality.

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: HOTGEAR
description:
Join HOTGEAR, a brand-new racing game where the thrill of the chase is just beginning. The pursuit is on, and it's time to put your skills to the test! The game offers a wide range of customization options, allowing you to create the car of your dreams and make every chase even more thrilling.
So, what are you waiting for, racer? The pursuit has begun, and you're wanted! Time to get in the driver's seat, customize your car, and take on the streets!

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!
description: Get ready for unbridled automotive chaos in Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!– a game where the three elements of extreme driving merge: devastating crash tests, masterful drifting, and frantic racing!

title: Dart Hero
description: Do you have the reflexes of a Hero? Step up to the line in Dart Hero, the fast-paced arcade game where timing is everything. Forget about complex aiming—just wait for the perfect moment and Tap to Shoot!

title: Colored Bricks
description: Colored Bricks is a fun and simple endless game. There are colorful bricks and one on the top. You should move that one to the right or left. When it hits the same color brick, it will destroy all bricks of the row. The challenge is to improve your high score in the limited time that you have! Some bricks have extra time if you destroy them.

title: Farm Blast
description: Farm Blast is a colorful level-based blast puzzle game set on a vibrant farm. Complete exciting objectives, overcome tricky obstacles, and unlock powerful boosters as you progress through hundreds of engaging levels. With bright visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and strategic gameplay, this addictive casual puzzle game is perfect for fans of match-3 games, farm games, and relaxing yet challenging brain teasers.

title: Special Holiday Solitaire
description:
Step into a festive world of fun with Special Holiday Solitaire! This cheerful card game combines classic solitaire gameplay with a holiday twist, creating the perfect escape for players of all ages.  
Whether you're looking for a relaxing break or a way to get into the holiday spirit, *Special Holiday Solitaire* is the perfect companion for the season. Challenge yourself, enjoy the magic of the holidays, and spread the festive cheer!

title: Racing Game King HP
description: Racing Game King is a racing game with a many game modes. So here comes the "Circuit race" against few rivals, where there is nothing more important than being first at finish line. Then a "Sprint race", a race from point A to point B. "Time-attack" - you vs. time, quite decent challenge. We also have a "Knockout race" here, where you should try to take place between the last two drivers. The  "Speed trap", where you have to pass certain points on the track at the highest speed possible.

title: Dress Up Run
description: Play Dress Up Runway, the ultimate fashion dress up game where style meets speed! Collect outfits, change looks on the go, and shine in the final runway walk. Perfect for players searching “dress up game,” “fashion game,” or “makeover run,” this stylish challenge lets you become a fashion queen while racing through exciting levels. With princess vibes, outfit makeovers, and endless glam fun, Dress Up Runway is the best free fashion challenge for US teens and students!

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Animal Link
description: Animal Link is a puzzle game, the goal is to remove all the squares by eliminating the same pattern. The rules of the game are simple and require a certain amount of observation and quick reaction ability.

title: BFFs Y2K Fashion
description: Welcome to BFFs Y2K Fashion, the exciting new fashion designer game that lets you explore the trend of the year 2000! With a wide selection of styles from the decade, you can create the perfect look and express your fashion sense. From skater girl skirts to ripped jeans and t-shirts, or even the classic Y2K look with fun-colored low-waisted jeans and crop tops, you can customize your outfit and become an ultimate fashion designer. Play now and let your style shine!

title: The White Room 4
description: The White Room 4 is an immersive escape game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills. Find yourself trapped in a hotel room and embark on a thrilling adventure to escape. Utilize the tools at your disposal, solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and crack passwords to unlock your path to freedom. Will you be able to conquer the puzzles and break free from this challenging escape experience?

title: Duo Family Santa
description: Steve and Alex need to race against each other. The one who holds the Lucky Block wins the game. Hold onto the Lucky Block until the time runs out to win the game. You can earn money by collecting socks and you can also earn money by defeating your friend. You must be very careful; steal the Lucky Block from your friend and keep it until the time is up.

title: Apocalypse Shelter
description: The world has fallen — but survival is still possible. Build and expand your shelter, manage resources, and create a safe haven in a hostile environment. Assemble a squad of unique heroes, each with their own abilities and combat style. Engage in tactical turn-based battles, plan your moves, and use your team’s skills to overcome dangerous enemies. Unlock new characters from chests, upgrade their cards, and build the ultimate squad to survive the apocalypse.

title: Day of Atrocity
description: Day of Atrocity is a voxel action game where you play as the hero, battling a relentless swarm of enemies that spawn at an increasing pace. Your objective is to stop them from overtaking the map by wiping them out before they dominate the entire space.

title: Epic Racing - Descent on Cars
description:
To tear yourself and your neighbor to shreds, but to reach the finish line first is an "Epic Racing - Descent on Cars"!

Epic collisions, a serious fight to the finish line and a million ways to bend and twist metal - that's what awaits you in the game "Epic Racing - Descent on Cars".

Burn rubber and tear metal - the game begins!

title: Super Sprunki Clicker
description: Enjoy the Sprunki World in this clicker idle game. Immerse yourself in the beats and music simulation, create the band, and use the rewards to buy new upgrades and features. Break the screen touching the sprunkis, hire automatic clickers, social media features, instruments, and everything to become the Sprunki King.

title: Arcade GP
description: ARCADE GP is a retro-style top-down Formula 1 racing game with strategic tire management and pit stop mechanics. Race against AI opponents, manage tire wear, and make tactical decisions to claim victory!

title: Cool Man
description: Hi there! It sounds like you're interested in playing Cool Man Adventure, To play, you'll need to jump & run on platforms, avoid obstacles and fire gas , robo, gear ring , and defeat enemies. Don't forget to collect key along the way! The game has 10 levels for you to explore, so there's plenty of adventure to be had.

title: Cupid Unchained
description:
Take aim, shoot true, and break the chains of fate!
Rescue trapped souls using your trusty bow as you solve clever physics puzzles, shatter chains, and free everyone before time runs out!

title: Falling Dummy
description:
Push the dummy off the roof of the tallest building on the construction site and watch it break all its bones. Control the body of the little man as he falls and break as many limbs as possible!

Do you want to relax after a hard day? Then this game is made for you! In this anti-stress game, your main goal is to make the dummy break as many limbs as possible when falling from tall buildings!

title: Granny 3 Return the School
description: The Granny Series continues with Granny 3: Return to the School. As Granny and Slendrina pursue you, you must discover the ammunition-filled pistol and all the keys to the classrooms of the deserted school. title: Match Dream Garden
description: What a beautiful garden! Match leaves, flowers, apples and other items to progress. Use power-ups like the Hammer to remove any piece, the Rake to clear an entire row or column, or the Gardening Gloves to swap two pieces.

Pop matching bubbles, trigger chain reactions, and enjoy dynamic, ever-shifting puzzles. Its colorful ocean setting, smooth mechanics, and playful movement create a relaxing yet engaging experience that’s easy to learn and satisfying to master.

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Emoji Sort – Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Emoji Sort is a fun and addictive sorting puzzle game where you match and organize cute emojis into the right tubes! Test your logic, plan your moves carefully, and enjoy hundreds of relaxing levels. Simple to play yet hard to master — perfect for puzzle lovers and casual gamers alike.

Play now and see if you can complete every emoji challenge!

Features: smooth animations, colorful visuals, satisfying gameplay, and brain-teasing fun made for everyone!

title: Smash Defense
description: Smash Defense is a chaotic baseball-inspired action game where your swings decide the fate of entire worlds. Crush waves of flying monsters using your bat and evolve your ball with fiery, electric, and explosive powers. Travel through dynamic environments like deep oceans and erupting volcanoes, upgrade your skills, and prove you’re the ultimate monster-slaying champion.

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Find It In The Haunted Mansion
description: “Find It In The Haunted Mansion” is a finding style game, where you are a detective and need to find all the keys hidden in each part of the house to complete all the levels.

title: Pyramid Jewels
description:
A fun and colorful puzzle game set in Ancient Egypt. Aim and shoot magical gems to match the same colors and make them disappear. 
Tests your aim and thinking as you clear the board and uncover the secrets of the pyramids.

title: Stickman vs Zombies WorldCraft
description:
Stickman vs Zombies WorldCraft is an action and adventure platform game in which you can play as a brave stick ninja. As your stickman hero, your mission is to wipe all the craft zombies. Along the way, you'll find money that you may use to unlock cool new skins.

Navigate the map in search of zombies before they track you down and rush you or open fire on you. Keep going, for the zombie craft will attempt to catch you if you leave even one alive.

title: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
description: Join us in the excitement as you follow the thrilling journey of teen Riri, who is preparing for the concert of a lifetime. From choosing the perfect outfit to applying stunning makeup, you'll get to walk her through all the steps of this beautifying process. But before you start the fun, be sure to help her customize her cowgirl hat, a signature item for the concert she will attend. Then go crazy with the makeup, dress her up in a jaw-dropping outfit, and accessorize for a complete look.

title: Office Spider Solitaire

Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Street Traffic Racer

Collect gold coins to unlock new, more powerful vehicles and boost your progress. Can you handle the speed and conquer the track? Find out in this thrilling, high-speed adventure!

title: Office Solitaire

Rival Christie, jealous rumors, and a flirty study partner turn the act into real complications. Choose outfits, make tough choices, and decide if this love is real—or just for show.
