Step into a realm of creativity and style where you become the master stylist of your enchanting paper doll dress up. With an expansive wardrobe featuring over 1000 fashion items, including the latest in trendy attire, distinctive accessories, diverse hairstyles, and soothing ASMR makeup touches, your creative potential is limitless.

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Hexa Tap Away
description: Hexa Tap Away is a sleek one-direction hex puzzle. Drag tiles to move them in the only direction they can travel, create space, and clear the board. Each level adds trickier layouts, blockers, and tight corridors that demand planning ahead. Short, snackable stages, smooth controls, and a clean look make it easy to start and hard to stop. Stuck? Try a hint or rethink your route and there’s always a smarter move!

title: Tralala La La La italiano
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure! In this game you will have to connect Italian animals. Collect a collection of rare animals, discover new species and create your own virtual zoo!

title: Sudoku Brain Blocks
description: Sudoku Brain Blocks is a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game that blends classic Sudoku logic with block-fitting challenges (Tetris style). Drag and drop various shaped blocks onto a 9×9 grid to complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear the board and earn high scores. Use strategy and planning to avoid running out of space and test your brain with every move!

title: Doors Awakening
description: This is a challenging puzzle-solving online game.  This game has wonderful 3D graphics enabling you to explore the handcrafted levels. The fascinating visual effects, realistic atmosphere, and natural camera controls will keep you returning for more. If you'd prefer puzzle games, don't miss this wonderful challenge.

title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
description: "Nuts & Bolts: Screw Glass" is a creative puzzle game. In this meticulously designed mechanical world, you need to match different screws to their corresponding colored boxes. Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

title: Brain Find Can You Find It
description: Brain Find brings new brain puzzles! Combine brain power and discovery for a brain challenge like no other! You can use your brain and reverse thinking to get the final target item. The unexpected way of passing levels can bring you endless laughs.  The game tests your logical thinking skills, reflexes as well as memory and creativity. Come and experience it and prove that you are the smartest!

title: Brick Match
description: Brick Match is a fast, fun puzzle game! Tap to match colorful bricks, trigger combos, and beat brain-teasing levels. Use boosters like the Shuffle, Colour Bomb, Extra Moves, and Row Blaster to blast through tough spots. Can you clear the board and beat your high score?

title: Sort Works: Nuts & Order
description:
Sort Works: Nuts & Order is a fun color-sorting puzzle game where you organize colorful nuts onto matching bolts.

? How to Play:

* Tap a bolt to pick up the top nut.
* Drop it onto a matching color or empty bolt.
* Sort all nuts by color to win!

? Easy to learn, challenging to master, with hundreds of levels and a clean mechanical design—perfect for puzzle fans and casual gamers!

title: Jumper's Quest
description:
Jump into a world full of unique obstacles that will test you both mentally and physically. Your quick thinking and reflexes will be put to the test as you decipher puzzles and navigate through each level with finesse.

Encounter a diverse array of enemies, each with their own unique challenges that you must conquer. Intuitive one-touch controls empower you to effortlessly jump through the levels in record time.

title: Fire snake
description: Help the fire snake slither safely home! Dodge dangerous obstacles, collect shiny coins, and master tricky levels. Can you guide the snake through every challenge? Play now and test your skills!

title: Food Sort 3D
description:
In this game, you manage your own food court, sorting various food items into their respective categories. You'll encounter different eateries, from fast-food joints to upscale restaurants, each requiring you to sort items like burgers,
sushi, hotdog, fries, pizza and desserts. The game features colorful graphics and quick, satisfying levels that keep you engaged as you expand your food

title: TRIVIA NATION
description:
Test your knowledge with quick and fun trivia questions!

Play through multiple categories including sports, movies, history, science, and more.
Challenge yourself in fast-paced quiz rounds and improve your brain skills.

Perfect for all ages — play solo or compete with friends and family!

• 400+ questions
• Multiple categories
• Fast and addictive gameplay
• Multilingual support

title: Merge Brainrot
description:
Drop and merge the most cursed Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Trallallero Trallala" to "Tum Tum Tum Saur! and "Boneca Ambalabu", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Conquer.io
description: Expand your zone and assert your dominance over every territory on the map. Plan your moves to outmaneuver opponents and gain as much space as possible. But beware, your rivals will stop at nothing to thwart your plans. Are you ready to claim your space?

title: Fish Jam
description: This game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts. The fish is trapped on the beach, and you need to come up with a reasonable moving plan to release the fish one by one from the crowded scene. Strategize to free the trapped fish on the beach, testing your problem-solving skills. With numerous levels that increase in difficulty, it's a great way to pass the time.

title: Fruit Match
description:
A fresh twist on fruit puzzles!
Tap two identical fruits to detach them and send them falling into the basket.

But it’s not that simple — fruits follow real physics. They can get stuck, stack, and only fall further when you clear what’s below.
Use gravity to your advantage, trigger chain reactions, and watch satisfying cascades unfold.

Clear the board and keep the flow going as new fruits drop in!

title: School Teacher Game School Day
description: Enter the world of teaching in School Teacher Simulator! Manage classrooms, inspire students, and experience the daily challenges of education. Plan lessons, grade assignments, and engage with students to create a dynamic learning environment. Customize your teaching style and watch as your students grow and learn. Are you ready to become the ultimate educator?

title: GT Championship Arcade
description: Get ready to ignite your engines and experience the ultimate rush of speed in GT Championship Arcade! This fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled racing game brings the excitement of GT racing into a visually stunning, arcade-style world filled with neon-lit tracks, intense rivalries, and heart-pounding action. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking for quick thrills or a hardcore racing fan seeking the ultimate challenge, this game offers an electrifying experience like no other.

title: Catch The Pig
description: This is a casual elimination game. The main purpose of the game is to find three identical pigs, catch them, and collect all the pig collections!

title: Crazy Bunnies
description: An exciting platformer about super bunnies in which you have to go through levels created in the style of Minecraft. There is a single and cooperative mode.

title: Blast Cubes
description: Blast Cubes is an addictive puzzle game where players strategically place cubes on a grid. When cubes align in horizontal or vertical rows, they explode, triggering an exciting chain reaction! After the explosion, characters of the same color as the exploded cube emerge and move towards vehicles of the same color waiting at the top. Once the vehicles are filled, new ones appear, continuing the cycle.

title: Princesses of Quadrobics
description: Two beautiful princesses, Eliza and the Little Mermaid, are waiting for your help in creating the perfect images for practicing Quadrobics. First, create a gentle but expressive makeup for each of the girls and put your hair in a comfortable hairstyle. Then choose dresses, jewelry and accessories. But the adventures don't end there! Complete the look by putting masks in the form of adorable animals on the princesses. After all, this is a mandatory part of the Quadrobics trend!

title: Little Lily Halloween Prep
description: Welcome to Little Lily Halloween Prep. It’s time to celebrate Halloween with Little Lily! Enjoy a memorable Halloween night with Lily and play fun-packed Halloween games and activities. Help the lily to complete her makeover, then help her with Halloween face painting. Browse her wardrobe and pick cute outfits and costumes. Finally, help her with cake decoration. A lot more to enjoy and explore this Halloween season with Little Lily. Happy Halloween!!

title: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle
description: Thief Puzzle is a funny and addictive casual puzzle game. Here you should help a clever stickman with many funny ways to solve puzzles and steal target items. The rich and varied game scene contains many unexpected obstacles and traps, testing your intelligence and logical thinking. Each level of the game is a unique challenge. To make flexible movements of the character to overcome obstacles, avoid enemies, and successfully steal the target item.

title: Fishing the Russian Way
description:
Embark on a journey through Central Russia: picturesque rivers and lakes, different types of fish, and the exciting process of fishing. Improve your tackle, control your rod, decide the fate of your catch, and add to your collection of rare finds.

Use your car to discover new locations, complete tasks, participate in tournaments, and receive daily rewards. Freedom of choice and the path to becoming a true fishing master await you!

title: Sprunki
description: Sprunki Challenge is a fun and character interactive music game where you can develop your rhythm skills. Mix rhythms, sounds and characters to create completely original tracks with instantly interacting characters. Drag-and-drop game mechanics allow for an unlimited number of combinations. This way, you will never get bored and create new rhythms and music every time you play. For the horror theme, you can drag the black button onto the character.

title: Headleg Dash Parkour
description: Touch controls have never been easier and more accurate! Run, jump, and climb walls just by tapping anywhere on. Pass the obstacles and raise the flag to complete the level. Difficult levels will make you addicted and feel challenged. complete all levels and try to unlock cute and cool skins

title: Stickman Guys Defense
description:
Stickman Guys Defense is an action-packed tower defense game where you must protect your base from endless waves of enemies! Command a team of brave stickman warriors, place them strategically, and upgrade their abilities to stop the invasion. From archers to sword fighters, build the ultimate defense and survive each level!

Can you defend your land and become the ultimate Stickman commander?

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure
description: Dive into a hilarious and action-packed adventure. Sausage Man Shooting Adventure is a fast-paced side-scrolling shooting game where you control a crazy, energetic sausage hero and blast through waves of enemies. Run forward, dodge traps, jump platforms, and shoot enemies with nonstop excitement! Collect airdrops to increase your damage.

title: Fighter Stick Hero
description: Welcome to Figher Stick Hero Stickman, an exhilarating 2D stickman game that will test your dueling skills. Whether you're playing in an arcade or survival mode, get ready to engage in intense battles against your opponents. Choose from a variety of weapons, character colors, and character decorations to customize your stickman. Remember to attack while moving to gain an advantage and earn higher scores by defeating other stickmen.

title: My Little Farm
description: Welcome to My Little Farm! Roll up your sleeves and dive into the world of planting, harvesting, and selling to meet daily demands. Upgrade your tools, nurture your crops, and keep the farm flourishing. Can you handle the never-ending requests and become the ultimate farmer?

title: Bomb Evolution
description: Bomb Evolution is a cannon-shooting arcade game. On the mysterious and mist-shrouded island, you have the opportunity to strategically establish not one, but three main bases, bolstered by an additional rocket. Engage in an enthralling battle against a formidable opponent, both of you operating under identical circumstances. Your ultimate objective: obliterating all the enemy's main bases positioned on the neighboring fog-laden island. May victory in this war be your prized accomplishment!

title: Mine Quest Daily
description: Uncover safe squares, avoid mines, and test your strategic insight in this massively addicting puzzle game!

title: Princess Dress Up Run
description: Run, collect, and dress up like a true princess. Race around the fantasy track. Collect all kinds of gorgeous princess dresses, shoes and accessories along the way according to the goal. Create the perfect princess look. And watch out for obstacles and traps, such as suddenly broken platforms, flames, etc.

title: Monkey Bubble Defense
description:
Survive the bubble invasion in this fast-paced 2D top-down tower defense game. Construct and upgrade various defensive turrets to take down hordes of bubbles.

Earn cash by popping bubbles. Use cash to to purchase new towers, upgrade existing ones, or sell for cash and reinvest into a different turret.

title: Dynamons 8
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 8! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Chinese Festival world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Robocanyx, Jaxaguar, Sauryx, Dagaryx and Tydonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: My Farm
description: Become the proud owner of your very own farm! Grow crops, tend to animals, catch fish, and set up production. Assemble collections of exotic animals in the zoo, meet the mysterious visitors, and embark on thrilling adventures!

title: Practice On Me
description: Get ready for a glamorous summer adventure with Practice On Me, the ultimate makeup game! Transform into a festival goddess, beach babe, or blooming flower child in three exciting themed units. Grab your brushes, swipe on lipstick, and let your inner artist shine. Dance at festivals, relax by the beach or embrace nature's beauty. With Practice On Me, the possibilities are endless. Make waves, channel your inner mermaid, and bloom like a flower. Experience a summer adventure like no other!

title: Moto Traffic Rider
description: Throttle the roaring engines of 6 awesome superbikes with insane speed limits and ride them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can ride and control these bikes and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Upgrade your bikes with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the rides. Are you ready to show your bike riding skills? Prove yourself in Moto Traffic Rider

title: Pixel Destroyer
description:
Pixel Destroyer is an exciting physics-based arcade puzzle game where your goal is to destroy colorful pixel shapes using bouncing balls.

Dive into a world of pixel destruction! In this game, you’ll need to use your wits and precision. Each level features a unique shape made of pixel blocks. Your objective is to destroy them all using a limited number of shots. The balls follow the laws of physics, bouncing off walls and obstacles, allowing you to reach even the most hard-to-access blocks.

title: Tung Sahur Coloring
description: Tung Sahur Coloring is a colorful joyride just waiting to happen! This super fun coloring game for kids turns every blank page into a chance to sparkle with creativity. Grab your virtual crayons and get ready to dive into the world of Tung Sahur, where imagination runs wild and colors know no rules. From cheerful characters to wacky shapes, each page is your personal canvas. Fill it with the wildest colors you can think of—green suns, purple trees, rainbow hats—anything goes here!

title: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle is a fun jigsaw puzzle game. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Challenge Your Friends
description: Challenge yourself! With seven different games, you can experience thrilling moments whether you're playing solo or competing against your friends. Drunken Duel, Tug The Table, Stick Duel, Milk The Cow, and many more games are waiting for you! Plus, to make the competition even more fun, you can choose exciting dares to make  the matches unforgettable! For those who prefer solo play, 6 games are ready to keep you entertained! Step into this world of fun and enjoy the thrill of competition!

title: Goon Ball
description: Fast-paced, two-player game where players try to control a "Goon Ball" to paint the  floor their color before time runs out.

title: Aim Ninja
description:
Aim Ninja is a fast-paced skill game that tests your timing and reflexes. 
Stop the moving needle at the perfect moment to score points and improve your accuracy. 
Simple to play but hard to master, Aim Ninja delivers quick, satisfying gameplay sessions 
for players of all ages.

title: Survival Island: EVO
description: Play a fun adventure and simulation game in Survival Island: EVO. You are alone on a mysterious island, and the challenge begins: survive, build, and thrive. Gather more resources like food, water, wood, and stone. And craft the tools you need to stay alive. Build your shelter, light a fire, and protect yourself from hunger and wild animals. Explore hidden corners of the island, discover secrets, and unlock new crafting recipes. Become the true survivor.

title: Screw Puzzle Master
description: Pull out the nuts and bolts and release the woods. Get ready for a fluent and entertaining screw puzzle! It is time to do some brain practice. Many game levels, entertaining puzzles, and super power-ups await you!  Challenge a friend and complete chapters as fast as you can. Place the bolts as strategically as you can. Buy different skins and play in a different ambient.

title: Capybara Suika
description:
Capybara Suika is a fun and relaxing food merge puzzle game starring adorable capybaras!
Inspired by the viral Suika Game, drop and merge food to grow bigger and score higher.
With colorful visuals, cozy vibes, and a tiny game size, it’s the perfect lite game to enjoy anytime!

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

title: Wild West Match 3
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Nautilus Spaceship Escape
description: There is an eerie silence on the Nautilus, an intergalactic spaceship. You have just been asleep when the power goes out for a moment. An uneasy feeling creeps over you - something is wrong here. Could there have been an attack? Get up, explore the surroundings and find out what has happened!

title: Stick vs Monster School 2
description:
Stick vs Monster School 2 is now fighting zombies!

He's in for fights and epic battles in the world during the zombie apocalypse!

Game features:
- Make cool shot
- Buy guns
- Fight zombies and bosses!

Did you like the game "Stick vs Monster School 2"? - Then write a review and play all our games about stickmen.

title: Classic Mahjong
description:
"Mahjong Classic" is a classic mahjong solitaire with a unique algorithm for generating levels - a random layout of chips always has a solution! Each playthrough becomes unique, allowing you to play your favorite fields an unlimited amount of times!
In the game you will find popular fields: Turtle, Fort, Crab, Spider, Cat, Dragon and many others.
Play solitaire at your own pace, there is no time limit!

title: Landmine Cube
description: In Landmine Cube you will you will take the role of a rolling cube that has to collect all the jewels in each level, without step on the landmines scattered around the floor. Every time you step on one of them, you will lose a life. If you lose all the lives, you will have to restart the level from the ground up. Do not worry, the Cube knows when a landmine is near, and it will start to glow boldly. Try your best and complete all the 21 levels of this engaging puzzle game!

title: Pixel Blast
description: Pixel Blast is a colorful online arcade game that mixes classic gameplay with modern design. Play for free on your phone or computer and enjoy smooth controls and vibrant pixel art. It’s easy to pick up and fun for players of all ages.

title: Overprotective Boyfriend
description: Imagine the beautiful Princess Marie standing in front of a mirror, looking at her reflection. Her eyes are shining, and a sly smile plays on her lips. She is ready to put on an outfit that will emphasize her grace and charm. But then her lover appears and frowns: «My dear, are you really going to wear such an open dress?» Marie knows that her faithful knight sometimes takes too much care of her, but today she intends to look dazzling!

title: Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve
description: Embark on a Brain-Twisting Journey with Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve, an exceptional wood puzzle game about nuts and bolts to test your IQ brain power. For nuts and bolts lovers who likes challenge and innovative gameplay, the right game for you - the ultimate puzzle game - is here.

title: Fitness Club 3D
description: Fitness Club 3D is a casual game where you plunge into the world of fitness and make every workout count as you strive to build an empire. Help your clients achieve their dream bodies and fitness aspirations while transforming your studio into the ultimate gym. Jump into the aerobics class, making a splash to rake in the cash. Pay close attention to your clients' forms, ensuring proper training techniques.

title: Sky Block Bounce
description: Welcome to Sky Block Bounce, the ultimate test of agility and strategy in a sky-high adventure! Your mission is simple yet exhilarating: jump on the blocks and navigate your way to the teleporter. But beware, each block behaves differently—some will vanish after just one jump, while others can withstand two or more.

title: Cat Chaos Simulator
description: Begin a fun 3D cat simulator adventure in the Cat Chaos Simulator. As a mischievous cat, chaos occurs in various scenes. Such as houses, parks and so on. Knocking over things, or messing with humans. In the Room Naughty, you jump on tables, knock over cups, destroy computers, etc. Keep destroying the furniture and see how far you can go with your mess value.

title: Shop Sorting 2
description:
Love organizing and keeping things tidy? Then Shop Sorting 2 is the perfect game for you! Step into a satisfying sorting puzzle where you arrange and categorize products in a well-stocked store.
In Shop Sorting 2, the challenge shifts from organizing specialty goods to managing the variety and chaos of a busy supermarket. Test your skills as you handle groceries, household items, and more. Enjoy rewarding match and sort gameplay, unlock new products, and upgrade your store layout.

title: Space.io
description: Jump into the cockpit of a powerful spaceship and engage in fast-paced 3D space battles! Face off against 9 other enemy ships in an intense dogfight where only the best pilot survives. Shoot down your opponents before they take you out, climb the rankings, and prove you're the ultimate space warrior! Unlock a wide variety of skins to customize your ship and dominate the battlefield in style. Can you claim the top spot?

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!

title: Monster Arena
description: Be the longest monster ever! Beat out your rival monsters by eating fruits and grows. This snake io game let you roam free, grow large, and finish your enemies by making them crash into you. Be the king of the island!

title: Block Digger
description: Dig, Click, and Get Rich! In Block Digger, every tap brings you closer to fortune! Smash stones, collect coins and crystals, and upgrade your mine to skyrocket your earnings. Unlock new mines, chase achievements, and build your mining empire. It's easy, fun, and totally addictive—start digging today! ⛏️

title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
description:
Nitro Speed Car Racing is a very unique racing game. You need to focus on the pointer on the dial and stop it at the right moment to get the Nitro that can help you rush to the finish line. This
is a test of your quick reaction ability. Of course, you can use the coins you collected in the game to upgrade your engine and nitro. Come to a brain contest, stimulate your dopamine, and
challenge your reflex limit!

title: Lollipop Stack Run
description: Dive into a sweet adventure in Lollipop Stack Run which is a colorful parkour game! In this fun arcade game, keep running while collecting vibrant lollipops to stack your sweet tower. You need to be flexible and glide between various obstacles, making sure to collect as many lollipops as possible during the run.

title: Blob Hero
description: In Blob Hero, you become a brave hero facing endless waves of enemies and monsters! This survival game offers a true rogue adventure experience. You control a blob hero, choose basic skills and upgrade to survive.

title: Starry Style Dorama of Dream
description: Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of Korean doramas heroes! Here you can become a stylist for two aspiring young film actors: a young actress whose heart beats to the rhythm of romantic stories, and a charismatic actor whose smile can melt even the coldest hearts. You will be able to choose from a variety of outfits, accessories and hairstyles, creating unique images that emphasize the individuality of your characters.

title: Room Sort
description: Welcome to Room Sort - Floor Plan Game, the ultimate free puzzle game that combines the fun of tangram puzzles with the creativity of home design. In this engaging game, you’ll rearrange room blocks to complete floor plans. Each room connects through doors, so you'll need to place them perfectly to create a cohesive layout.

title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
description: This is an addictive cooking-themed merge game you won't be able to put down. Here, you'll become a kitchen master by merging identical ingredients and dishes to create new, more delicious cuisine. From simple vegetables to exotic feasts, continuously unlock tasty recipes from around the world. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins, and use them to upgrade and decorate your kitchen, transforming it from a humble diner into a dream culinary paradise.

title: Slingshot Fortress
description: Slingshot Fortress is an addictive 2D physics-based destruction game where precision, timing, and strategy are essential. Use your slingshot to launch stones, bombs, and shurikens to destroy towers, collapse structures, and uncover hidden enemies. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Ocean Small Hospital Doctor
description: Dive into the exciting world of Ocean Small Hospital - Doctor! This casual and educational game is an absolute blast for animal lovers. In this game, you'll step into the role of a heroic doctor on a submarine-turned-hospital. Your mission? Rescue injured sea animals from the vast ocean depths. As you spot a distressed creature, quickly assemble your medical team and gear.

title: Mahjong Pet Quest
description:
Dive into the colorful and engaging world of Mahjong Pet Quest, a fun and relaxing puzzle game where classic Mahjong meets adorable animal tiles!
Replace the classic Mahjong tiles with cute animal-themed ones! Each tile brings a charming, delightful touch to the game.
Explore a variety of levels, each designed to test your skills and logic. The difficulty increases as you progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged!

title: Stickman battle 1-4 Players
description:
Cool collection of dynamic action games!

Fight with rotating weapons, score goals in football, Take first place in a long race, Complete difficult survival levels and much more.

There is a quick round for a couple of minutes and a tournament for several rounds.

You can play up to 4 players, play with friends and bots.
You can change the player's appearance: change cars, faces, color.

Play and have a lot of fun!

description:
Choose your character, roll the dice and go on a fun adventure.
Click on monsters - help the hero survive and defeat the legendary dragons in the clicker RPG Dragon Hunter.
Luck and a strong phone glass will determine the fate of the dragon hunter.

title: Color Block Jam
description: Color Block Jam – an exciting puzzle game! Move the colored blocks, solve logic challenges, and complete levels. The game has many levels, from simple tasks to real brain teasers.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

description: In The Best Warrior, you start as a humble peasant with one goal—to become the greatest warrior in the kingdom. Train by clicking on dummies to build attack power, defeat enemies for gold, and unlock powerful skins to grow even faster. Face epic bosses, collect timed chest rewards, and rise through multiple levels. With nonstop action, upgrades, and progression, this free adventure clicker game lets you prove your strength with every tap. Start your journey now and become a legend!

title: Bubble Shooter Pop
description: Get ready for a nostalgic blast from the past with Bubble Shooter Pop - Blast Fun, the ultimate classic bubble shooter game! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant bubbles, addictive gameplay, and endless excitement.

title: Tie-Dye Explosion of Color
description: Welcome to the new game for girls who love juicy colors and stylish outfits. In this game you will meet two girlfriends: the self-confident Kaylee and the sweet Marie. The game begins in a world painted in bright colors, where girls want to create the most unusual and colorful outfits using the Tie-Dye technique. Join creative girlfriends and create the brightest and most stylish outfits in the world of Tie-Dye!

title: Labo Brick Train Game For Kids

You can't miss our game if you are interested in all this.First of all, you need to pick out your favorite train style. Then start assembling the train from the locomotive, followed by the body.

title: Goal io

Score wild goals, dodge rivals, and outplay opponents in quick matches that test reflexes like a competitive brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for short breaks. title: Mobile Phone Case Diy
description: This is a mobile phone case game that was designed. Have you ever wanted to create a fashion phone case of your own? In the game, you can show your creativity, enjoy the art of customisation and see your phone evolve the way you like. You can choose your favourite colours, draw, mix, and spray paint your phone case.

title: Fusion 2048
description: Fusion 2048 is an addictive puzzle game where you combine matching numbered blocks to reach higher values and aim for the elusive 2048 block. Play in Classic or Shape Mode, plan your moves to avoid filling the container, and use TNT blocks to clear space. With clean visuals, smooth controls, and score tracking, it’s perfect for quick sessions or long strategic runs—easy to pick up, hard to master.

title: Stickman Jailbreak Story
description:
An exciting puzzle game in which the player will have to help stick make a daring escape from prison. Stick found himself in a sinister prison, from which there is no way out, except for various ingenious paths, hidden objects and puzzles.
The player will explore the various rooms of the prison, paying attention to every small detail and examining objects in search of key clues. Each room is filled with riddles, traps and various items that can be used to escape.

title: Nutcracker New Years Adventures
description: Welcome to the world of a fairy tale, where two princesses are preparing for a series of winter holidays. Each of the princesses is working on creating her own unique New Year's outfit, inspired by Hoffmann's mystical fairy tales and Tchaikovsky's classical ballet. Immersing themselves in the atmosphere of New Year's magic, players will be able not only to dress princesses, but also to develop their sense of style. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure and create your own New Year's image!

title: Seat Puzzle Cut The Rope
description: Face a wildly satisfying brain challenge in Seat Puzzle - Cut The Rope. This addictive puzzle game blends smart logic with relaxing casual gameplay, creating the perfect experience for those who love thinking fast and solving clever challenges! In each level, chairs are bound by ropes. Your task is to cut the ropes according to the passengers' colors.

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a battle-royale shoot-em-up game with 2D cartoon models. In 4 modes, you can shoot other players to earn scores for coins and gems. Then you can buy more roles and guns in the Shop. Your character can aim at the closest target automatically so that you only need to fire and dodge bullets from enemies. More kills and less death will make you claim more coin and gem rewards. Good luck!

title: Draw Brige Puzzle
description:
Draw Bridge Puzzle Game is an exciting and challenging brain game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test.
In this bridge-building adventure, your task is to draw paths for the car to safely navigate through obstacles and reach its destination.
Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of bridge construction and puzzle-solving as you draw roads to rescue the stranded car!

title: Number Master Run And Merge
description: Number Master: Run And Merge is an awesome number racing game that lets you run, merge, and upgrade on a parkour platform to become a true number master! Control your number character as you run through dynamic tracks. Keep collecting more numbers and expanding. Merge with matching numbers to grow stronger. The bigger your number, the more unstoppable you become! Pick the smartest paths, hit speed zones, and keep your speed maxed out!

title: Draw War
description: Unleash your creativity in Draw War. This is a wonderful strategy game. Here drawing meets battles. Build a hero lineup, draw your legions, then unleash the power of your army. The numbers show the soldiers summoned. Click to send Shielded Soldiers, Soldiers on Horseback, or Super Beasts.

title: Dynamons 12
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 12! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Guardian Tomb world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons Captain Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon trainer. Encounter the 8 titans from the Guardian King: Bearmoryx, Sharkonyx, Crocynos, Horzaryx, Visi, Rhinodys, Fenixaro, Uryndur and many more special Dynamons.

title: Crazy Tunnel
description: Crazy Tunnel is a fast-paced, first-person arcade game. Navigate through the tunnel at breakneck speeds and aim for the longest distance possible.

title: Money Chaser- City Parkour Game
description:
Chasing/Running eldnlessly for collecting coins(Money).
Try to avoid traps & *kick out all the enemy/competitors on your way.
*You can kick out enemy infront of you with slide skill*

After you have enough money, you can challenge the Boss fight.
The amount of coins(Money Bullets) is the only weapon to defeat Boss, the more the better.

Remember, no money no life...just keep running :)

title: Skyscraper to the Sky
description: Challenge your skills as an engineer and architect in this  puzzle game. Build the tallest, most stable skyscraper across 30 levels, from small houses to huge buildings.

title: Fruit Catcher
description:
Catch as many fruits as you can before they fall! ?
Move your basket left and right to collect fresh fruits and avoid rotten ones. Each fruit gives you points — how high can your score go?
This fun and colorful game tests your reflexes and speed. Perfect for kids and casual players who love simple but addictive gameplay!

title: City Drift Racing
description: "City Drift Racing" is an atmospheric racing arcade game where crazy competitions await you on the streets of the metropolis.

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Shape Transform Blob Racing
description: Shape Transform: Blob Racing is a casual running game. In this game, you will control a little Blob, running, shape-shifting, and go through various challenges! It would help if you quickly switched the Blob’s shape while running to navigate various obstacles. For example, turning into a ball helps you roll through narrow passages. When you become a square, it helps you cross flat areas more  easily.

title: Volley Bean
description: Volley Bean is a simple and easy to learn volleyball game. With simple controls and fast paced gameplay volleyball never been more entertaining. The variety of boosts spawn randomly on the screen doubles the fun.

title: College Girl Coloring Dress Up
description:
BFF high school fashion makeover: coloring book & cool dress up games for girls!
New college girls dress up game & coloring book is here for you! Dress up the most popular high school girls, create their whole look, paint and color. These cool coloring pages and clothes design features made especially for fashion girls. Begin total fashion makeover with our girl dress up games!

Design outfits like a fashionista: dress up, choose hairstyle, necklaces and other amazing accessories such as skirts and dresses. Select a color and click on the fragment you want to color, when the painting of college girl is created, start drawing and coloring, become BFF fashion clothes designer.

Take screenshots, save as wallpaper, and share cute coloring pages with your friends and family absolutely for free.

title: Skillful Finger
description: Touch the screen and slide your finger along the glowing line without lifting it. Avoid barriers, stay clear of the edges, and react quickly as the speed increases. Customize your ball and tail, face dynamic obstacles, and enjoy endlessly generated paths that keep every run fast, challenging, and addictive.

title: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game
description: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game is a chaotic puzzle hunt where you track a target brainrot through surreal, meme-soaked worlds. Each level pushes you to spot the same creature across dense, absurd scenes packed with icons like 67, Strawberry Elephant, Dragon Cannelloni, Spaghetti Tualetti, and La Supreme Combinasion. Fast-paced scanning, wild details, and pure internet nonsense create a frantic, high-energy experience for fans of intense spotting and brainrot chaos.

title: Nightmare Couple Halloween Party
description: Nightmare Couple Halloween Party is a spooky and stylish dress-up game where you can help the ultimate nightmare couple prepare for their eerie Halloween bash. Select from a variety of creepy costumes, haunting accessories, and makeup styles to give the couple their perfect spine-chilling look. Unleash your creativity and fashion sense to make this Halloween party an unforgettable one for the nightmare couple!

title: Bolts and nuts
description:
The game Bolts and Nuts is a logic puzzle? in which you have to unscrew bolts from planks?! Your task is to choose the right bolt to unscrew? so that you can unscrew all the planks ✌!
Compete with friends and colleagues ?!

title: Arrow Sorting
description: Arrow! Sorting Food is a satisfying puzzle adventure where every move changes the board. Tap the arrows to unravel colorful fruit chains, clear paths, and untangle tricky patterns across countless levels. Unlock new visual themes, collect fun skins, and enjoy relaxing yet brain-teasing gameplay that grows more challenging with every stage. Simple to learn, surprisingly addictive to master!

title: Exit - Puzzle
description: Embark on an exciting journey in Exit - Puzzle, a captivating game where your mission is to rotate the puzzle and guide the ball to the exit! Each level presents new challenges, requiring you to think creatively and find the best route. Twist and turn the puzzle to navigate through obstacles and unlock the path forward. With a variety of levels and progressively harder puzzles, this game will keep you entertained and engaged.

title: Falling Man
description:
Fall for fun in this addictive hypercasual game!
Ready for a wild ride? Join the thief as he falls from dizzying heights, dodging obstacles and collecting coins in this addictive hypercasual game. With two distinct locations to explore and endless possibilities for high scores, the fun never ends in this exciting game.

title: Super Tank Wrestle
description: Welcome to the world of tank battles, where you can control tanks to fight with other enemies on different maps. There are also a wealth of tanks for you to choose from!

title: Idle Archer Tower Defense RPG
description: Welcome brave archer heroes to the enchanting realm of Idle Archer Tower Defense RPG! Embrace the role of a solitary archer, unyielding in defending their towering stronghold against relentless tides of monstrous adversaries. With an unwavering determination, you pledge to safeguard the realm from the nefarious creatures summoned by the sinister dark Lord. Engage in a battle to fortify your tower, enhance the skill set of your valiant archers, and triumph over malicious waves of malevolence.

title: My Tiny Land
description: An ultra-quiet and super stress-relieving fruit and vegetable matching game with hundreds of types of fruits waiting for you to collect.

title: Liquids Sort Puzzle
description:
Colorful, bubbling, fragrant, and iridescent concoctions fill flasks, jugs, and test tubes in varying proportions!

Figure out strategy and create harmony by collecting liquids of different colors and properties in different containers!

Test your attention and reasoning skills in this meditative puzzle game. 

Many levels of increasing difficulty and bonus tasks await you! 

Excellent attention training and good mood guaranteed!

title: Sniper Freeze
description: Experience thrilling sniper action in Sniper Freeze, a unique online game where you hunt down moving rule-breakers marked in red. Sharp graphics and challenging gameplay await - stay alert and precise!

title: Bubble Mania Shooter
description: So easy to play, yet challenging to master - welcome to the wonderful bubble universe! Get ready for a game with colorful shooting action where the fun never ends! Sharpen your aim, perfect your shots, blast bubbles, and claim the highest score.

title: Chain Cube 2048 3D Merge Game
description:
Ready to challenge yourself? Chain Cubes 2048 is an addictive merging puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merging games. Believe it or not, it's much
harder to put together 2048 cubes than it is to throw away the numbers. If you fail to merge the cube number blocks, they will bounce off each other!  Keep playing and eventually complete 2248 number puzzles!

title: Cooking Stories: Fun cafe game
description:
Become the host of the popular transformation cooking show — Cooking Stories! You are not just a chef, you are a culinary genius, a style master, and an interior designer. Participants come to you at their most desperate moment: they urgently need help — and only you can change and save their lives!

But that’s not all...  
Take a peek behind the scenes of the TV show: intrigue, emotions, unexpected twists — all this in the game Cooking Stories!

title: Labubu Pop
description:
Labubu Pop is a bright and cheerful puzzle game where the playful Labubus have completely taken over the box! Connect matching characters into chains, clear the board, and earn points to level up. Each stage brings fun surprises, and even more exciting combos!

With its colorful visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet addictive gameplay, Labubu Pop is perfect for relaxing and having fun anytime. The longer your chain — the higher your score and the flashier the effects!

title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
description: Discover a new genre in the world of puzzles! This game intertwines block puzzles with a thrilling adventure on tropical islands! Complete levels to earn stars, unlock new territories and unique relaxation areas. From snow-white beaches to dense jungles – each location is filled with unique challenges. The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game.

title: Fish Shooting Fish Hunter
description: Want to begin a fun and relaxing fishing adventure? In Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter, you’ll become a fishing master. Use your skills and quick reflexes to catch various fish while enjoying a laid-back casual experience!
